title: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions
mechanism: Bidirectional CNN-transformer fusion injecting multi-receptive-field conv features into a plain ViT, pretraining-free.
adaptation: Alternative to ViT-Adapter on DINOv3; run only the one that ports to the timm DINOv3 model with less work.
min_experiment: Same as ViT-Adapter arm; kill same.
evidence: R: ViT-CoMer-L 64.3 AP COCO val2017, 62.1 mIoU ADE20K val.

alt_notes.adaptation: Alternative to ViT-Adapter on DINOv3; run only whichever ports to the timm DINOv3 model with less work; same decoder and schedule.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Replace ViT-Adapter in the same arm; same baseline, metrics and kill line. About 25 GPU-h.
